study.question: Can target-aligned partitioning BEFORE nonlinear history scoring improve click AUC over the incumbent and matched partition/uniform controls, without new learned parameters, under the frozen four-task offline protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observed: match-value detail (0.663019) exceeded count-only (0.660944), and coarse linear/quadratic summaries improved the branch, but later match-order, energy, cubic and feedback fifth-channel replacements did not exceed their strongest duplicate controls. In the latest round aligned feedback AUC0.665690 exceeded rotated0.665420 and gated-duplicate0.665106, yet lost to the exact incumbent bridge0.665930; this is an unsuccessful replacement, not a rejection of feedback in general. The primary base still scores ten block means before count-weighted pooling. A nonlinear scorer generally does not commute with averaging mixed matching/nonmatching events; linear residual moments need not repair that loss. Partitioning each ten-event block by the union of valid item/category/brand matches, then scoring both stratum means, may retain useful target-conditioned mixtures for the existing task-specific adapters. This is a provisional implementation hypothesis, with no novelty or effectiveness claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary v4 sections4.2-4.3 lines232-277 inspected: DIN uses target-conditioned unnormalized local activation of event embeddings. We inherit that scoring principle and the local field/task adaptation. The proposed difference is deterministic target-ID partitioning before scoring compressed means, plus inherited task-specific residual summaries and gradient ownership. This is not a new claim about target-aware attention.

Exact incumbent candidate.py SHA2566b404ecb67390cd4bc5b0fba904eef689e61aea7679dafee128e0a0b41395b01 verified. Replace only primary base readout and its compressed scorer population; retain embeddings, five residual summaries, adapters, towers and loss. Incumbent bridge is byte-identical.

Available module and validation receipt reviewed. That branch replaced a fixed fifth residual direction with orthogonal union-feedback alignment and lost to the bridge. This proposal leaves every residual coefficient intact and intervenes upstream in primary compression, using target identity matches instead of feedback membership.

Cached primary benchmark section2.3 describes UniMixer flattening histories, EST repeated cross-attention/feature-specific FFNs, and LONGER learned local grouping. None is reproduced here. Deterministic two-stratum block means with a shared DIN scorer are the narrow local contrast. Original-method detailed novelty remains unverified.

inherited_components: All frozen inputs, masking, labels, task ordering, training seed/recipe, full validation scorer and resource accounting
Unnormalized action-aware DIN scorer, four task towers, five incumbent residual summaries, zero-initialized task adapter bank and its initialization order
Auxiliary scorer parameter stop-gradient with cloned state buffers; auxiliary item/action embedding stop-gradient and live context gradients
Ten chronological array blocks, released historical feedback union for auxiliary compression only; ordinals are not elapsed times
study.proposed_difference: For each block form seven slot means in fixed order: uniform, auxiliary-negative, auxiliary-positive, target-nonmatch, target-match, rotated-nonmatch, rotated-match. Match means any equality in item_id/cate_id/brand after zero/padding/OOV exclusion and history masking. Rotate the binary union membership by floor(valid_count/2) among VALID events within the same block, preserving its cardinality; no RNG or external IDs. All three new cells construct and score the exact same70-slot population in the same order and execute the same learned modules. Primary base is count-weighted sum over aligned pair (candidate), rotated pair, or uniform slots (controls); auxiliary training scores only the original30 slots through the detached-parameter functional scorer. Evaluation reuses the primary scores for those auxiliary slots. The same five incumbent summaries feed the same adapters. No new learned parameters. Fourth file is the byte-identical incumbent source as a same-seed reproduction/cost bridge. New-cell versus bridge changes primary Dice population from30 to70; the common-population uniform control isolates this confound for interpretation. Candidate/control main contrasts hold population fixed.
predictions: Target-aligned AUC should exceed rotated and uniform controls and the incumbent0.665930, as well as both frozen source bests0.660647/0.660163. Exceeding only source bests adds no evidence beyond the existing incumbent.

All three new cells have identical learned capacity and initial scorer/embedding/tower/adapter states; differing selected primary bases are intentional. The uniform control measures effects of the expanded scorer normalization population versus the bridge.

Each aligned and rotated split covers valid events exactly once, conserves each block total count and embedding sum, and preserves pair counts. With a constant scorer all primary choices coincide; with nonlinear scoring heterogeneous mixed blocks can differ. Empty histories give zero pooled bases and zero residual correction.

Any local gain is expected to be associated with mixed target-match blocks; report their actual prevalence if host diagnostics are available. Short/empty histories and blocks with all/none matches have little direct compression benefit. Rotation can leave the partition unchanged or merely complement it; report this limitation.

Report all four AUC/logloss, click history slices, train/inference time, peak memory, batch p50/p95 and throughput. Auxiliary performance may change through shared context/scorer states and is not assumed to improve.
falsifiers: Aligned fails to exceed either rotated, uniform or the incumbent: no useful target-alignment support for this implementation, even if it beats a weaker reference.
Uniform matches or exceeds aligned and improves similarly over the bridge: changed Dice population/optimization, not target-specific partition benefit, explains the result.
Rotated matches or exceeds aligned: extra within-block partition resolution or its optimization is an adequate explanation; no alignment mechanism established.
Matched cells differ in learned parameter count, common scorer population, initialization, information visibility or masking: attribution invalid until corrected; costs retained.

Failure of masking, finite gradients, source ownership, host cap or justified quality-cost comparison invalidates feasibility. Single-seed small differences or validation-search selection do not establish repeatable benefit.
alternative_explanations: Added scorer FLOPs/activation capacity rather than target matching; parameters alone do not measure capacity
BatchNorm/Dice population and training-versus-evaluation state effects; uniform control is essential
Membership count distribution, deterministic rotation artifacts and degenerate aligned/complement partitions
Many adaptive validation comparisons, one training seed and random initialization/optimization sensitivity
The existing branch trades auxiliary quality for primary click quality; click selection is not a joint Pareto claim
Target matches are encoded feature equality under whole-window benchmark vocabularies, not evidence of production point-in-time availability

Stratum sums may partly be recoverable from the inherited match moments/counts; any gain can reflect a more useful inductive bias or easier optimization rather than uniquely new information. Task-specific adapters are fixed, so this suite does not establish an interaction with task conditioning; a later sharing factorial would be required.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved card and primary benchmark section2.3 line17 inspected. Flattening is a broader alternative to compression but carries learned projection cost; no local transfer evidence. Prior usage consideration is provenance, not support, and latest feedback extension failed against its bridge.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None from UniMixer: no flattening/tokenizer/mixing block used. The changed mechanism is ID-aligned partitioning before nonlinear compressed scoring, selected from local match-detail and failed residual-extension evidence.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Deterministic masked block strata through inherited DIN scorer, rather than flattened learned chunk tokens. Original-method novelty unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: These trials cannot reject UniMixer; a separate matched-cost comparison would be needed.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved card and primary benchmark section2.3 line33 inspected. Target-dependent retrieval is relevant context; repeated cross-attention and feature-specific FFNs change additional factors and are not adopted.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None from EST: no cross-attention stack or feature-specific FFNs. Partitioned compression reuses the existing shared scorer.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: One fixed target-ID partition before scoring, not iterative learned retrieval. Original EST paper not fully audited, so no originality claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Failure here tests this fixed partition, not EST or heterogeneous retrieval generally.
